name: ArgoNeuT
summary: ArgoNeuT was a small liquid-argon time projection chamber in the NuMI beam, providing early US neutrino-argon measurements and practical reconstruction experience for larger LArTPC experiments.
physics_targets: Charged- and neutral-current neutrino-argon cross sections
Nuclear effects and exclusive hadronic final states
detection_principle: Neutrino interactions ionize liquid argon. Electrons drift to angled wire planes, whose arrival times and charge provide three-dimensional tracking and calorimetry. Tracks exiting downstream are matched to the MINOS near detector for muon momentum and charge.
